mapper.select: select leave_request_id as business_id, user_id, shop_id, status, business_round, approval_instance_id, row_version, last_approval_event_key from oa_attendance_leave_request where leave_request_id = #{businessId} for update

select leave_request_id as business_id, user_id, shop_id, status, business_round, approval_instance_id, row_version, last_approval_event_key from oa_attendance_leave_request where leave_request_id = #{businessId}

select correction_request_id as business_id, user_id, shop_id, status, business_round, approval_instance_id, row_version, last_approval_event_key from oa_attendance_correction_request where correction_request_id = #{businessId} for update
mapper.update: update oa_attendance_leave_request set status = #{targetStatus}, last_approval_event_key = #{eventKey}, row_version = row_version + 1, update_by = 'approval', update_time = #{decisionTime}, approved_at = case when #{targetStatus} = 'APPROVED' then #{decisionTime} else approved_at end, rejected_at = case when #{targetStatus} = 'REJECTED' then #{decisionTime} else rejected_at end, cancelled_at = case when #{targetStatus} in ('CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED') then #{decisionTime} else cancelled_at end where leave_request_id = #{businessId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and row_version = #{expectedVersion}

update oa_attendance_correction_request set status = #{targetStatus}, last_approval_event_key = #{eventKey}, row_version = row_version + 1, update_by = 'approval', update_time = #{decisionTime}, approved_at = case when #{targetStatus} = 'APPROVED' then #{decisionTime} else approved_at end, rejected_at = case when #{targetStatus} = 'REJECTED' then #{decisionTime} else rejected_at end, cancelled_at = case when #{targetStatus} in ('CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED') then #{decisionTime} else cancelled_at end where correction_request_id = #{businessId} and status = #{expectedStatus} and row_version = #{expectedVersion}

update oa_attendance_day_result d join oa_attendance_schedule s on s.schedule_id = d.schedule_id join oa_attendance_leave_request r on r.leave_request_id = #{businessId} and r.user_id = s.user_id and r.shop_id = s.shop_id set d.settled_at = null, d.result_status = 'PENDING', d.exception_codes = 'LEAVE_DECISION_CHANGED', d.row_version = d.row_version + 1, d.calculated_at = #{decisionTime}, d.update_by = 'approval', d.update_time = #{decisionTime} where s.status in ('PUBLISHED', 'CHANGED') and timestamp(s.business_date, s.start_time_snapshot) < r.end_time and timestamp( case when s.cross_day_snapshot = 1 then date_add(s.business_date, interval 1 day) else s.business_date end, s.end_time_snapshot) > r.start_time

update oa_attendance_day_result d join oa_attendance_correction_request c on c.correction_request_id = #{businessId} and c.schedule_id = d.schedule_id set d.settled_at = null, d.result_status = 'PENDING', d.exception_codes = 'CORRECTION_DECISION_CHANGED', d.row_version = d.row_version + 1, d.calculated_at = #{decisionTime}, d.update_by = 'approval', d.update_time = #{decisionTime}
